body.description: Rustbed: a small rusty ranch pickup truck creature, headlight eyes, a grille shaped like curved cattle horns across its front, cargo bed on its back loaded with junk, four wheels, never quits hauling. a small living machine creature (an Ohm), an old household or farm machine that woke up with a will of its own, weathered by years outdoors, no humans, no rider
body.style_description: modern indie action-adventure pixel art: chunky stylized proportions, big bold readable silhouette, saturated colours, lineless with strong graphic light and shadow shapes, expressive and punchy
